title: Cold Storage Request Form
subtitle: Cold Storage Control: defines need, constraints, and assignment.
description: Cold Storage Request Form covers storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition. The cold-storage operations owner records Cold Storage Control need, timing, access, and assignment. Cold Storage Request Form keeps Cold Storage Control exceptions visible until the cold-storage operations owner handoff.
use_case: Use Cold Storage Request Form at cooler, freezer, cold room, loading interface, and affected product zone. Document storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition identity before Cold Storage Control begins. Compare storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition findings with stated Cold Storage Control criteria; route unresolved Cold Storage Control issues to qualified product-condition reviewer. For Cold Storage Request Form, confirm requirements for Cold Storage Control. Ask qualified product-condition reviewer to review Cold Storage Control conditions beyond the cold-storage operations owner's role.

sections.title: Request context and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Cold Storage Control, identify responsible parties, cooler, freezer, cold room, loading interface, and affected product zone, and the linked storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition source.

sections.guidance: Capture Cold Storage Control facts for storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Request routing and requester follow-up
sections.guidance: Resolve open Cold Storage Control request questions; have cold-storage operations owner record the assignment, response owner, and requester follow-up while keeping the record strictly at the intake and routing stage.

blocks.label: Scheduling constraints, holds, and supplied evidence
items: Product moved or released without qualified disposition
Prior or requester-supplied: time-stamped logger and manual readings
Prior or requester-supplied: device and calibration identity

blocks.guidance: Do not assign or authorize the Cold Storage Control request when temperature history, device reliability, affected scope, containment, or qualified product disposition remains unresolved. Retain information supplied with the request and route unresolved constraints to cold-storage operations owner.
